# Diuretics and congestion monitoring

Loop diuretics relieve congestion in heart failure. A weight gain of two to three pounds in a day,
or about five pounds in a week, suggests fluid retention and often prompts a temporary increase in
the diuretic dose. Rising resting heart rate, new shortness of breath at rest or when lying flat, and
new swelling in the legs are warning signs of decompensation that warrant clinical review.
